text:
sarah: Quick postmortem note for the Stagelight dedicated on-prem incident — root cause looks like two things: flaky VPC peering sessions at the customer edge and an on-prem router config that intermittently drops SYN+ACKs when NAT sessions exceed ~65k.
aj: copying my notes from the debug session — found repeated BGP flap logs at ~11:34, then our probe retries stacked up and exhausted the KV cache TTL which caused a short isolation window.
maria_g: is there a minimal repro or packet capture we can share with Stagelight? I want to prototype a retry-safe path in the runtime.
sarah: yes — attached pcap in the ticket. ops-bot: jira/INC-14922 created: https://redwood/jira/browse/INC-14922 :link:.
leo: cc @staging-network-team — I already asked the customer to preserve the router config and avoid restart until we pull captures. Customer said they can keep it for 48h.
aj: action for network debug: aj -> collect BGP neighbor stats, capture every 5m for 6 intervals, and run `show ip bgp neighbors`/`tcpdump -n -s 0 -w capture.pcap port 179`. Due EOD Thu.
maria_g: action for runtime: maria_g -> add defensive backoff around peering handshake and guard the KV cache eviction during retry storms. PR + e2e by next Tue.
sarah: action for customer ops liaison: leo -> coordinate filter changes (remove NAT session limit) and get confirmation from Stagelight network engineer. Target 72h.
leo: noted. I'll escalate to their infra lead — if they want a maintenance window we can do a rolling restart after config change.
aj: FYI this pattern (BGP flap then token/kv eviction cascade) looks like it's popped up twice in last 6 months across dedicated customers. We should add a monitoring signal for 'peering flaps -> cache pressure' correlation.
sarah: agree. action for product/observability: sara? (cc @maria_g) — create an alert rule and dashboard widget showing handshake errors + cache evictions. Q: owners?
maria_g: I'll work with monitoring infra to spec the metrics. I'll own the dashboard creation. ETA 1 week.
ops-bot: linked boards: https://redwood/boards/remediations/INC-14922 and runbook stub created at /runbooks/onprem-peering-quirks.md.
sarah: blockers: we need a signed consent from Stagelight to run a controlled peering test (packet injection) — leo please push for an approval.
leo: pinged them, they asked for a short test plan. I'll draft and post here by morning.
aj: small troubleshooting note for eng-runtime — when you add backoff, also avoid linear retry backoff that doubles memory pressure; prefer capped jitter. Example snippet: ```python
for attempt in range(max_try):
    await asyncio.sleep(min(base * 2**attempt, cap) + random_jitter())
```
maria_g: thanks, will use capped exponential with jitter.
sarah: timeline summary: network captures + customer approval (48–72h), runtime PR + e2e (next Tue), dashboard & alert (1 week). I'll update the postmortem doc and tag owners.
leo: will update INC-14922 with customer reply and maintenance window options.
maria_g: will open a follow-up RFC if the runtime changes need wider rollout.
sarah: thanks all — please drop short status updates in this thread daily until closed. :eyes:
